user_preference_pip_name_length.name: user_preference_pip_name_length
user_preference_pip_name_length.value: "user_preference"."pip_name" is null or ("user_preference"."pip_name" = btrim("user_preference"."pip_name") and char_length("user_preference"."pip_name") between 1 and 16)

user_preference_home_point_valid.name: user_preference_home_point_valid
user_preference_home_point_valid.value: ("user_preference"."home_latitude" is null and "user_preference"."home_longitude" is null) or ("user_preference"."home_latitude" between -90 and 90 and "user_preference"."home_longitude" between -180 and 180)

user_preference_home_city_length.name: user_preference_home_city_length
user_preference_home_city_length.value: "user_preference"."home_city" is null or ("user_preference"."home_city" = btrim("user_preference"."home_city") and char_length("user_preference"."home_city") between 1 and 120)

expense_fx_provenance.name: expense_fx_provenance
expense_fx_provenance.value:
("expense"."fx_rate" is null and "expense"."fx_source" is null and "expense"."fx_as_of" is null)
        or ("expense"."fx_rate" ~ '^[0-9]+(.[0-9]+)?$' and "expense"."fx_source" is not null and "expense"."fx_as_of" is not null)

post_place_name_length.name: post_place_name_length
post_place_name_length.value: "post"."place_name" is null or ("post"."place_name" = btrim("post"."place_name") and char_length("post"."place_name") between 1 and 120)
